sn56.2:1.1: bhikkhave yogam āpajjatha || paṭisallīno bhikkhave bhikkhu yathābhūtam pajānāti || Kiñca yathābhūtam pajānāti || || Idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || ayam dukkhasamudayo ti yathābhūtam || pe || ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || || Paṭisallāṇe bhikkhave yogam āpajjatha || paṭisallīno bhikkhave bhikkhu yathābhūtam pajānāti || ||
sn56.2:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || || Ye
